observation.visible_scene: Outdoor, sunlit shot framed against leafy trees and blue sky. On the left a person in a pale shirt extends both arms; the right hand is pressed flat against a large pink inflatable ball that bears a printed yin-yang-style symbol, while the lower left hand hangs open beneath it. On the right, a thin metal wand/nozzle angles upward and emits a fine water spray toward the ball's right side.
visible_changes: The pink ball is already inflated and continues to grow larger across the segment: the printed symbol visibly enlarges and the ball's overall diameter increases, indicating ongoing expansion rather than a new onset.

The ball drifts upward within the frame; its top edge, initially well inside the view, moves out of the top of the frame by the end, so the growth is accompanied by upward translation of the object (background trees stay put, so this is object motion, not camera pan).

The person's right hand remains in contact with the ball but shifts slightly relative to the surface as the ball expands under it; the open lower left hand stays largely stationary with only minor repositioning.

The water spray from the wand persists throughout; the broad white mist cloud at the upper right thins out over time while the spray becomes more concentrated as a localized burst of droplets at the point where the wand tip meets the ball's right edge.
The wand's apparent angle/position relative to the ball changes modestly as the ball rises and expands, but the nozzle itself stays fixed at the lower right of the frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: What inflates the ball (the spray or a separate unseen source) and whether the ball eventually pops or the action ends.
The state of the ball before this excerpt and its fate after the last frame.
Whether any person is holding/aiming the wand.
uncertain_details: Exact magnitude of ball expansion versus simple approach toward the camera.
Any very slight camera movement, since the background gives little evidence of panning.
Precise cause of the upward drift of the ball.
